title: ModelPrediction
description: Unified scorer output consumed by the policy engine. Every model (Freeman primary or supervised baseline) MUST expose risk_score in [0, 1] via a predict_proba-compatible interface.

risk_score.description: Probability-scale risk in [0, 1]. Policy thresholds are defined on this scale. Freeman serving maps logrisk → [0,1] (documented in model artifact metadata).

logrisk.description: Native Freeman sum of per-feature LLRs. Null for models that do not produce logrisk.

feature_schema_version.description: Must match the feature-vector schema version the model was trained/served against (1.0.0 for FeatureVectorV1).

contributions.description: Per-signal explanation terms. For Freeman: LLR contributions keyed by FREEMAN_FEATURES. For supervised models: SHAP or coefficient×value terms keyed by FEATURE_NAMES.

contribution.description: Signed contribution to risk (positive increases risk).

detail.description: Optional human-readable note (e.g. 'IP not previously seen').
